title: [Bug] Anthropic API rate limit error in Xcode while other Claude clients unaffected
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude code in Xcode reports "The request would exceed your account's rate limit" but I can still use the Mac Claude app and console. This started a few days ago (today is 2 December) and continues. I try to use Claude in Xcode once a day and receive the same error. Claude (in his support guise) and I chatted about this and he/it/whatever seems to think it's an issue with Xcode not updating usage data correctly. I'm a little dubious because as soon as I signed up for Claude, it worked fine, and then Xcode updated usage such that it said I ran out of tokens or something. Anyway, regardless, something is not working and I am not able to use the Xcode plug-in for Claude. I killed Xcode and tried again, and that didn't work. I rebooted my Mac (the ctrl-alt-del solution) and that didn't work.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macOS 26.1
- Xcode: 26.1
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.0.42
- Feedback ID: 91aff7a3-c577-49ca-8753-279a244e85aa

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: Could not resolve authentication method. Expected either apiKey or authToken to be set. Or for one of the \"X-Api-Key\" or \"Authorization\" headers to be explicitly omitted\n    at validateHeaders (/$bunfs/root/claude:669:935)\n    at buildHeaders (/$bunfs/root/claude:669:8438)\n    at async buildRequest (/$bunfs/root/claude:669:7504)\n    at async makeRequest (/$bunfs/root/claude:669:3332)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2025-12-02T19:44:52.792Z"}]
```
